assert_tensor_shape: assert a PyTorch tensor has the expected shape dimensions using assert_shape
validate_probability_tensor: validate that a tensor contains valid probability values summing to one with is_prob_tensor
validate_log_probability_tensor: assert a tensor contains valid log probabilities using assert_logprobs
check_one_hot_tensor: check if a tensor is a valid one-hot encoded tensor using is_1hot_tensor
add_bos_eos_tokens: prepend BOS and append EOS tokens to a one-hot encoded sequence tensor with add_eos_bos
